Habe das Spiel kurz nach release damals noch auf der XBox 360 und habe es damals schon geliebt <3 Es hat mich einfach der Mix des Spiels total gecatched und das hat es jetzt wieder, hab mir devinitiv Zeit gelassen beim Durchzocken, da ich es quasi nochmals "zum ersten mal"  gespielt habe, immerhin sind mittlerweile ein paar Jährchen vergangen und ich wusste nur noch ganz, ganz grob um was es ging und wie es sich spielt, aber genau wie damals hat mich der Mix aus dem Zelda ähnlichen Weltenaufbau und Progression-System (man braucht Item oder Fähigkeit "X" um die Welt weiter zu erkunden und voran zu kommen), dem God of War ähnlichen, wuchtigen Kampfsystem und dem Devil May Cry ähnlichen Waffen Upgrade System (auch wenn ich persönlich kein wirklicher Fan von Hack 'n Slash Games bin... hatte damals auch Devil May Cry und ich meine mich erinnern zu können, dass ich das Spiel nie abgeschlossen habe. This game is amazing! But the recent update did mess up some stuff.

Look, Darksiders is a fantastic game. It combines the combat of the original God of War games, with Zelda-like dungeons and the absolutely incredible art style of comic legend Joe Mad. It's a 20 hour epic and still the best one of the 4 Darksiders games (which includes Genesis; not Darksiders 4 which was recently announced). 

On a technical level, this Warmastered edition adds some graphical improvements to the original, which I played on the Xbox 360 when it came out. So if you're looking to start playing, this edition is the way to go. It's not perfect though, as the screen tearing which plagued the original is still very much present here. And since there are barely any video settings to optimise, there's not much you can do to fix it. V-sync did not appear to help, I'm sorry to say. But honestly, it's not that big an issue.

But then, the update came. When I was about 14 hours in, Vigil updated this 10-year-old game and I honestly believed it made things worse. The screen tearing got way, way worse and all of a sudden I ran into bugs that I haven't experienced in the 1.0 version. At one point I fell through the floor to this infinite drop that could only be fixed by resetting the game. I lost about 30 minutes of treasure hunting, so nothing major, but annoying none the less. Add some minor inconveniences, like being unable to climb demon growth every first attempt and getting stuck in gravity for a couple of seconds (I really have no other way to explain it), my last couple of hours began to feel a bit more like a chore. The fact that the end is mostly a fetch quest doesn't help, but I actually enjoyed doing that. Because going through some important levels with new-found abilities, did grant me some time to look for missed treasure chests.

So yeah, magnificent game. Would defenitely recommend. But if you experience the issues I mentioned here, maybe stick to the vanilla Warmastered version that is still available through Vigil.

Что можно сказать про эту игру? В детстве она представлялась как-то иначе... Было ощущение захватывающего приключения и борьбы за праведные цели. Сейчас она ощущается как олицетворение фразы Вааса из Far Cry 3: [i]"Я уже говорил тебе что такое безумие, а? Безумие - это точное повторение одного и того же действия раз за разом в надежде на изменение. Это есть безумие."[/i] 

Почему? Ответы у меня следующие: 
1) Да, хоть локации друг от друга визуально и отличаются, гейм-дизайн, все дела, но заниматься необходимо всегда и везде до ужаса репетативными занятиями: ой вей, враги преграждают путь? Война крушить, Война ломать. Ой вей, закончились противники? Держи загадку, где надо в очередной раз каким-нибудь способом забросить мину на наросты. Ой-вей, подобное повторяется 3/4 игры? Держи портальную пушку, дабы помучиться еще немного;
2) Система прокачки. Печально, что душ и опыта просто-напросто не хватит, если фармить их по ходу пьесы, обязательно необходимо изгаляться и стакать всадников в пепельных землях или носиться вокруг да около скопления пауков в Железном своде; ну а что, у разработчиков на этом полномочия все, окончены.

В остальном: достаточно приятно побыть в шкуре одного из четырех Всадников Апокалипсиса, выполнять различного рода экзекуции мечом, косой, перчаткой. Сражаться за праведное дело для восстановления справедливости. Только хохма в том, что справедливости-то и нет...

A classic action adventure game. The combat and puzzle design were good at the time of release and hold up well in this remaster. The art direction and graphical style are timeless and will always look good. 
The story was much better than I remembered, I was excited to see where it went next after each one of the distinct sections.
I really enjoyed the first 4 dungeons and I was very impressed with how well paced they were bouncing between challenging (not unfair or hard) combat segments and puzzles with new mechanics being added often.
The 5th dungeon however did bring the game to a screeching halt for me. A difficulty spike in the combat and a tedium spike in the puzzles heavily drag down the last dungeon, which took me about 2.5 hours game time to complete. It does detract from the game overall unfortunately and really sticks out in my memory since it was right at the end. 
After the final dungeon, the game does get relatively back on track with a classic (as in there's a reason we stopped doing this) fetch quest that was meh and an okay final boss. 

Overall I did enjoy the game. The first 4/5 of the game are a solid 8/10, the last fifth unfortunately is a 6/10 with bloat and being dragged out for the sake of extending the completion time. 

I do recommend the game, but with an asterisk.
